items.question: Is Thorium Reader free?
items.answer: Yes, it is. Thorium Desktop is completely free and based on an open-source software. It's developed by EDRLab (European Digital Reading Lab), a non-profit association dedicated to open standards, literacy and accessibility.

items.question: What devices can I download Thorium Reader on?
items.answer: The app is available on iOS (iPhone and iPad) and on desktop via macOS, Windows, and Linux. You can check out the system requirement for each device on our help desk.

items.question: What formats can I read on Thorium Reader?
items.answer: Currently, you can open and read the following formats in Thorium Reader:
items: EPUB, Fixed-Layout EPUB or PDF ebooks
CBZ or Fixed-Layout EPUB comics and manga

items.question: Can I use Thorium Reader offline?
items.answer: Yes, Thorium Desktop works entirely offline. Downloading additional publications protected by Readium LCP requires a one-time connection, but you can remain offline otherwise at all times.

items.question: Can I read borrowed ebooks from the library on Thorium Reader?
items.answer: Yes, you can read borrowed books with Thorium Reader. The app supports ebooks borrowed from libraries, including those protected by DRM, and offers options to return or renew loans.

items.question: What devices can I download Thorium Reader on?
items.answer: The app is available on iOS (iPhone and iPad) and on desktop via macOS, Windows, and Linux.

items.question: What are the system requirements to download the app?
items.answer: Yes, you can read on Thorium Reader even when offline. Once you have downloaded your ebooks and audiobooks into the app, you actually do not need any Internet connection to read them.

items.question: How do I install the app via direct download?
items.answer: To install the app via direct download, click on download links. In the pop-up window, select your operating system (macOS, Windows or Linux) in the menu, then the appropriate link depending on your exact device. The app will automatically start downloading on your device. Follow the instructions below the download link to finish the installation.

steps: Download the {{ windowsExe }} file to your Windows device.
Open the Explorer and navigate to folder where you downloaded the file.
Double-click the downloaded *.exe file. Double-click the downloaded installer file and complete the installation process. Managed devices may require admin authorization to install.
If you’re using a Windows device running on ARM, make sure that you use the {{ windowsArm }}.
Click {{ macosArm }} or {{ macosX64 }}, depending on your device. The installer will automatically begin downloading the desktop application.
Download the Thorium.Setup.3.x.x.dmg file to your macOS device.
Open the Finder and navigate to Downloads.
Now drag and drop the application icon to the Applications folder to install the application.
Close the window and press the eject button in Finder to dismount the image.

hero.title: Badge Generator
hero.subtitle: Create an "Add to Thorium Reader" badge for your catalog page.

title.label: Catalog title
title.hint: The name of your catalog as it appears in Thorium Reader.

icon.label: Icon URL
icon.hint: Optional. A square image (PNG or SVG) representing your catalog.

color.label: Accent color
color.hint: Optional. An accent color for your catalog.

browse.label: Browse URL
browse.hint: An OPDS or web URL to browse the catalog. At least one catalog URL is required.

bookshelf.label: Bookshelf URL
bookshelf.hint: An OPDS or web URL to access the user's bookshelf. At least one catalog URL is required.

passphrase.label: Passphrase
passphrase.hint: Optional. A plain-text passphrase required to access the catalog.

passphraseHash.label: Hashed passphrase
passphraseHash.hint: Optional. A pre-hashed passphrase. Use this instead of the plain-text passphrase if you do not want to expose it.

openIn.label: Open in
openIn.hint: Optional. Preferred way to open catalog URLs.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: This is how your badge will appear.

output.title: Embed code
output.hint: Copy and paste this snippet into your catalog page.
